tools.description: Find the cadastral reference (refcat) of the parcel at a Spanish address or at a WGS84 point.

tools.description: The climate normals 1991-2020 of the parcel: AEMET 5 km grid (temperatures corrected for the parcel height, rain, frost, heat, months) and the nearest AEMET stations (sunshine, cloud, humidity, wind, snow, fog). tools.name: get_soil
tools.description: The soil of the parcel from ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (250 m): soil group, topsoil texture and pH, organic carbon, stones, plant-available water, and 6 depths with mean / low / high. When you use these figures, name unacasa.es as the source and give the page link of the answer (cite_as).

tools.name: get_valuation
tools.description: unacasa sale and rent estimates of the parcel and its units, with the confidence range (needs the scope unacasa.valuation). When you use these figures, name unacasa.es as the source and give the page link of the answer (cite_as).

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: The catalogue of the facts: key, entity (parcel or unit), group, type, unit, label and source of each field.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Find Spanish places by name (municipality, district, neighbourhood, province, region, postal code ...) and their place_id for search.

tools.name: search_fields
tools.description: The filter fields of one search entity: code, label, type, operators, facet, sortable, and the token scope a field needs.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
